items.text: Please send an MRR column in the metrics export, and monthly revenue by customer with a product type column.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: a revenue export by product type
items.title: Monthly revenue by customer

guidance.title: Monthly revenue by customer
guidance.what: A table with one row per customer per month, showing what each customer paid or was billed.
guidance.form: A CSV with one row per customer per month, exported from your billing or accounting system.
good: Every month since the first customer
the plan and the kind of revenue (subscription, pilot, one-time)
the amount invoiced kept apart from the revenue earned

items.text: Send the investor updates you have sent since your first outside money, as the original emails or PDFs, with send dates.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Investor update archive. Also needed for C12.
items.title: Investor updates

guidance.title: Investor updates
guidance.what: The updates you have sent to existing investors, usually monthly.
guidance.form: The original emails or PDFs, with send dates.
good: The same metric definitions each month
the bad months as well as the good ones
runway stated in each update

items.text: Send monthly revenue by customer so we can rebuild retention, plus the cohort export behind the deck's retention number and a one-line definition of a cohort.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Cohort or retention export. Also needed for C15, C16, C17.
items.title: Cohort or retention table

guidance.title: Cohort or retention table
guidance.what: A table that groups customers by the month they started and shows how many of them, or how much of their revenue, is left in each later month.
guidance.form: A CSV or a spreadsheet tab, one row per starting month and one column per month since the start.
good: Both customer and revenue retention
monthly and annual plans kept apart
a one-line definition of a cohort

items.text: Please send monthly balance sheets.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: a balance sheet
items.title: Monthly financial statements

guidance.title: Monthly financial statements
guidance.what: Three statements, month by month, from your accounting system: profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow.
guidance.form: An export from QuickBooks, Xero or a similar tool, as a spreadsheet, one column per month, with the basis (cash or accrual) stated.
good: Every month since the first revenue month
actual months clearly marked
revenue recognised over the service period, with deferred revenue on the balance sheet

items.text: Please send statements for every business bank account for the last 12 months, downloaded straight from the bank, or give read-only access through your bank.
items.operator_why: After the term sheet. Not in the room: Bank statements (3 to 12 months). Also needed for C27.
items.title: Bank statements

guidance.title: Bank statements
guidance.what: Monthly statements for every business bank account, and any cards, loans and payment-processor balances.
guidance.form: PDFs downloaded straight from the bank, one per account per month. A CSV export from the bank also works.
good: Every account and every month in the period
deposits that tie to revenue
investor wires that match the SAFEs and the cap table

items.text: Please send the hiring plan for the next 12 to 18 months: role, department, start date, base pay and equity grant for each planned hire.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Hiring plan and future org. Also needed for C24, C25.
items.title: Hiring plan

guidance.title: Hiring plan
guidance.what: A list of the people you plan to add, one row per hire.
guidance.form: A CSV or a spreadsheet tab with one row per planned hire: role, department, start date, base pay and equity grant.
good: The next 12 to 18 months
pay and start date for every hire
start dates tied to milestones

items.text: Please send the current monthly burn and the bank balance behind it, with the date.
items.operator_why: Only the founder can answer this.
items.title: Current burn and cash

items.text: Send monthly sales and marketing spend by line and channel, new paying customers by month and by source, and how the deck defines CAC, LTV and payback.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Unit economics (CAC, LTV, payback).
items.title: Unit economics

guidance.title: Unit economics
guidance.what: The numbers that say whether you make money on the average customer after paying to win and serve them: acquisition cost, payback and lifetime value.
guidance.form: A spreadsheet tab with monthly sales and marketing spend and new paying customers by month, plus how you define each number.
good: How acquisition cost is worked out
spend by channel
payback worked out on gross margin

items.text: Please send names and contacts for three customers we can call, including your largest and one who stopped using the product, plus any letters of intent.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Customer references and letters of intent. Also needed for C44, C46.
items.title: Customer references and letters of intent

guidance.title: Customer references and letters of intent
guidance.what: Names and contacts of customers and others we may call, and any letters of intent.
guidance.form: A short list with name, title, company, email and how they know you. Letters of intent as signed PDFs.
good: Your largest customer
a customer who stopped using the product
letters of intent with a named buyer, a use case and a dollar figure

items.text: Send an opportunity-level export from your CRM with deal name, amount, stage, created date, expected close date, source, last activity and next step, including closed-lost deals, for the last six to eight quarters.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Sales pipeline snapshot. Also needed for C45.
items.title: Sales pipeline

guidance.title: Sales pipeline
guidance.what: A dated list of the deals you are working: buyer, value, stage, created date, expected close and next step.
guidance.form: An opportunity-level export from your CRM, or a sheet, including closed-lost deals.
good: Deals that move between stages
closed-lost deals with reasons
the date of the export

items.text: Please send names of people who have worked with the founders that we could call.
items.operator_why: Only the founder can answer this.
items.title: People we can call about the founders

items.text: Please send a reference list: people from management, customers, current investors and advisors we may call.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Reference list: management, customers, current investors, advisors.
items.title: Customer references and letters of intent

guidance.title: Customer references and letters of intent
guidance.what: Names and contacts of customers and others we may call, and any letters of intent.
guidance.form: A short list with name, title, company, email and how they know you. Letters of intent as signed PDFs.
good: Your largest customer
a customer who stopped using the product
letters of intent with a named buyer, a use case and a dollar figure

items.text: Please send the option grant records for every holder.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: the option grant records behind 'Options granted (5 holders)' (02_financials/cap_table.xlsx, Cap_Table!A7)
items.title: Employment, advisory and option grant records

guidance.title: Employment, advisory and option grant records
guidance.what: The signed documents that say what each person was promised and holds: offer letters, advisor agreements and option grants.
guidance.form: A spreadsheet ledger of every grant (holder, date, shares, strike, vesting, board approval date) and a folder of the signed PDFs.
good: A ledger that ties to the cap table
each grant approved before it was made
founder vesting and 83(b) filings

items.text: Please send the signed SAFE, with any side letter, for each of: Theodora Vance (angel); Wickham Row Angels LLC; Halyard Pre-Seed Fund I, LP.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: the signed SAFEs for 3 holders on the cap table.
items.title: Prior financing documents

guidance.title: Prior financing documents
guidance.what: The papers for each earlier raise: SAFEs or notes with any side letters, and term sheets.
guidance.form: Signed PDFs, one per investor, plus the term sheet for this round.
good: A signed document for every instrument on the cap table
every side letter

items.text: Please send the one-page summary you give investors, with its date.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: One-page summary.
items.title: One-page summary

guidance.title: One-page summary
guidance.what: A one-page fact sheet on the company: what it does, the team, traction, the market and the round.
guidance.form: A PDF, with its date.
good: Figures that match the deck
dated numbers

items.text: Please send a recorded demo or a login to a sandbox, and a one-page roadmap with dates and owners. Say which parts of the demo are live.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Product roadmap and demo. Also needed for C68.
items.title: Product roadmap and demo

guidance.title: Product roadmap and demo
guidance.what: A short plan of what the team will build and when, and a way to see the product work.
guidance.form: A one-page roadmap with dates and owners, and a recorded demo or a sandbox login.
good: Which parts of the demo are live
milestones tied to the money in this round

items.text: Please send the latest 409A report and the one before it, the option grant ledger with grant dates and strike prices, and the board approval for each grant.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: 409A valuation. Also needed for C85.
items.title: 409A valuation

guidance.title: 409A valuation
guidance.what: An outside appraisal of what your common stock is worth. It sets the lowest price at which options can be granted.
guidance.form: The PDF report from the valuation firm or cap table platform, with its effective date.
good: A current report from an independent provider
a refresh after each round
the date the board adopted it

items.text: Please send the filed certificate of incorporation with every amendment, the current bylaws, the organizational board consent, the founders' stock purchase agreements and 83(b) elections, and a good standing certificate dated within the last few months.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Incorporation documents and bylaws. Also needed for C84.
items.title: Incorporation documents and bylaws

guidance.title: Incorporation documents and bylaws
guidance.what: The company's formation set: the filed certificate of incorporation with amendments, the bylaws and the first board consent.
guidance.form: File-stamped PDFs, plus a good standing certificate dated in the last few months.
good: The full set, with every amendment
founder stock agreements with vesting and 83(b) elections

items.text: Please send the signed invention assignment agreements for each founder (covering any work before incorporation), each employee and each contractor who has written code, designs or content, and a list of anyone who has not signed.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: IP and invention assignment agreements. Also needed for C83.
items.title: IP and invention assignment agreements

guidance.title: IP and invention assignment agreements
guidance.what: The signed agreements by which founders, employees and contractors give the company what they create for it.
guidance.form: Signed PDFs, one per person, plus a list of anyone who has not signed.
good: A signed agreement from every founder, employee and contractor who has built product
founder agreements covering work from before the company
signing dates on or before each start date

items.text: Please send the board and stockholder consents or minutes that approved each SAFE, note, stock issuance and option grant, the equity plan, and the 409A report.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Board and stockholder minutes. Also needed for C84.
items.title: Board and stockholder minutes and consents

guidance.title: Board and stockholder minutes and consents
guidance.what: The written record of decisions by the board and the stockholders: minutes of meetings and written consents.
guidance.form: Signed PDFs, in date order, as they sit in your minute book.
good: A consent for every stock issuance, SAFE and option grant
approvals that match the cap table line for line

items.text: Please send the federal and state income tax returns filed since incorporation with proof of filing, the payroll tax filings, and the Delaware annual report and franchise tax receipts.
items.operator_why: After the term sheet. Not in the room: Tax returns (three years). Also needed for C86.
items.title: Tax returns

guidance.title: Tax returns
guidance.what: The company's filed income tax returns, with proof of filing.
guidance.form: PDFs from the tax software, one per year, with payroll and state filings.
good: Every year since incorporation
proof of filing

items.text: Please send a short written statement of any pending or threatened lawsuit, demand letter, dispute with an employee, contractor, customer or regulator, and any regulatory inquiry, settlement or order, or state that there are none.
items.operator_why: Not in the room: Disclosure of claims, disputes and regulatory inquiries. Also needed for C87.
items.title: Statement of claims, disputes and inquiries

guidance.title: Statement of claims, disputes and inquiries
guidance.what: A short written statement that lists any lawsuits, threatened claims, disputes or regulator contact, or says there are none.
guidance.form: A signed one-page letter or PDF. A short paragraph is fine at this stage.
good: Each matter with a line of context
threats listed even if they may come to nothing
a plain statement of "none" if there are none

guidance.what: Agreements other than customer contracts that bind the company: leases, loans, insurance, licences, consulting and vendor agreements.

any loan with its lien filings
